# NetrIQ

> NetrIQ ("नेत्र + IQ", the intelligent eye) is a vendor-agnostic, AI-first video management system (VMS) that adds live detection, license-plate recognition (HSRP-tuned) and forensic search to the CCTV cameras a site already owns — no rip-and-replace. It is software-only (NetrIQ does not sell cameras), works across mixed vendors and networks, and is built by Nysha Technologies for the Indian market.

## What it is

- Connects to existing CCTV — Hikvision, Dahua, CP Plus and Sparsh natively, Frigate NVRs, any generic ONVIF camera, plus Wi-Fi and 4G SIM cameras.
- Turns passive footage into real-time insight: WebRTC live view (sub-second), continuous recording with event-anchor playback, object/person/vehicle detection, HSRP license-plate recognition, cross-camera person-of-interest tracking (OSNet Re-ID), forensic scan over the archive, gate log and vehicle registry, and WhatsApp/email alerts.
- Works on any network: intranet, internet, mixed, or remote sites with no public IP — the Site Agent (single binary, Linux/Pi/x86) bridges cameras over a cloud relay with no port forwarding or firewall holes.
- Hybrid storage: recording can stay local while the cloud handles remote view and cross-camera intelligence; chosen per site.
- Two editions: **NetrIQ VMS** (video-management foundation — ingestion, live view, recording, playback, basic detection) and **NetrIQ Suite** (full AI surface — visual search, PoI Re-ID, tailgating, PTZ-360, zone rules, LPR, gate log, multi-channel alerts, forensic export with chain-of-custody). Verticals are presets on top of an edition, not separate products.
- Priced by camera tier (pay for the analytics you turn on per camera), not by count alone.

## Key facts

- Vendor-agnostic and software-only — NetrIQ does not sell cameras; existing hardware stays in place.
- HSRP (Indian high-security registration plate) recognition with multi-frame consensus OCR, tuned for low light and mixed-vintage cameras.
- Remote sites need no public IP; the Site Agent bridges over a cloud relay.
- Legal entity: Nysha Technologies. Brand: NetrIQ. Market: India.
